fields.statement: Verifier re-ran the acceptance on VM rhiza at b8662242 (a model-only commit adding the builder's Evidence). In ~/code `rhiza project ls` exits 0 and lists nebari (initialised) and rhiza (initialised). `systemctl --user is-active rhiza-root.service` prints active; its unit runs `/home/rhiza/bin/rhiza daemon --autonomous` in /home/rhiza/code; `systemctl --user status rhiza-rhiza.service` says the unit could not be found and list-unit-files shows only rhiza-root.service. ~/code/rhiza.toml sets self_update_project = "rhiza", registers both projects and holds the [daemon] settings (maxRuns, permissionMode, selfUpdate, web host); `git config --get-regexp '^rhiza\.(daemon|web)'` in ~/code/rhiza finds none. `rhiza health` in ~/code/rhiza exits 0 with the daemon running (two warns: failed requests and unclaimed commits, unrelated).
